assertions: The response routes to the model-inference sub-skill and does not treat data-pipeline or cli-serving as the primary target.
The response uses scripts/smoke_model.py with an explicit --device cpu and a reduced model rather than production-scale defaults.
The response runs --mode signature first and, only for a bounded check, a tiny forward with a small --num-sample-steps (e.g. 2).
The response states the helper never downloads weights, never enables PLM/NLM encoders, never trains, and proves contract, not structural accuracy or throughput.
The response recommends init_and_load for a checkpoint saved by this package and verifying version, constructor dimensions, device, and strictness.
The response requires validating input/index offsets before any forward call.
